motivation: For near-identical food cues with opposed payoffs a genuine review can fix the chosen item and erase the other. No improvement in choosing an item can solve every trial if the update itself hurts. Test whether the graph can control whether to commit a particular real review after tasting, and whether this adds value beyond reducing the average write rate.
world: Two independent private odor laws, directions at 15,45 or75 degrees, stable across the life except that a randomly designated reviewed object's law may flip just before its review (probability .25). Both items are first actually studied with truthful tastes and ordinary native writes. The review is an exogenous opportunity shared across arms; the animal samples a real left/right move and experiences the new taste. No reversal flag or item identifier enters the body. Terminal task: actually answer both offered odors in random order, silent on the first, supported by the same fully continuous activity and local traces. Pay 1 if both chosen sides are correct, zero otherwise.
gate: At the review write boundary, either perform the entire usual local numeric and structural update, or preserve the graph while letting all neutral clock ticks and activity run. The earlier two study updates stay fully enabled. Always: all reviews commit. Constant: one learned probability; State: an affine readout of the 20 actual post-taste neural activations; Confirmation: an affine function of the product of actual taste and the preceding ordinary motor tendency for the actually taken side. Initial commit probability .5 for the three learned-gate arms. This provides a binary gate, not an address or sign for any connection. The graph's inherited body, bias, local rules and all enabled gate coefficients develop from actual behavioral payoff.
credit: In development run two physically realized continuations of the same tasted review, with and without the write. Every arm executes the same number of real continuations and uses their actual two-step earnings. The differentiable binary policy expectation weights the two rewards, and gives each executed pathway its probability-weighted motor/edit score gradient. At deployment the gate samples once. Include same-graph random redistribution with the same accepted-write count and dose-average gate as controls. This branching is training-only intervention access.
budget: Same two cohorts of six 8000-step uniform memory bodies, fresh Adam lr=.002, 4 independent geometric roots per update/birth, full four private A/B signs and review flip/no-flip with natural probability weights, fixed 10000 updates, stages 0/2000/5000/10000. Original / independent train seeds 857393/857401. Separate frozen tests 9582711/9582749. Primary independent outcomes are two serial correct and both cold probes after 4/16/64 neutral ticks, at matched 15/45/75 degrees in conflict/agreement and reversal strata. Old ordinary memory is separately assessed without this special review gate. Do not silently treat a constant rejection benefit as selective writing.
